title: The Strongest Magician in the Demon Lord's Army was a Human
altTitles: Maou Gun Saikyou no Majutsushi wa Ningen datta
Maou-gun Saikyou no Majutsushi wa Ningen datta
synopsis: Ike is a powerful magician and the leader of the Immortal Brigade, part of the Seventh Corps of the Demon Lord’s Army. He single-handedly conquers fortresses and pushes back the armies of humanity. Neither Dairokuten, the Demon Lord, nor Ike’s loyal soldiers know his darkest secret—he is a human in hiding! But can he keep his secret safe and bring peaceful coexistence to demons and humans?
